entries.name: Agile
entries.ruleText: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

entries.name: Ambush Beacon
entries.ruleText: Friendly units using Ambush may ignore distance restrictions from enemies if they are deployed within 6" of this model.

entries.name: Ambush Re-Deployment
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when a unit where all models have this rule ends its activation, you may immediately remove it from the table (dropping any objectives it might hold within 1"), and deploy it as if it had Ambush at the beginning of the next round.

entries.name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

entries.name: Anti-Cover
entries.ruleText: This weapon ignores Cover.

entries.name: Anti-Cover Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Anti-Cover when Shooting
entries.ruleText: This model gets Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Anti-Cover when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Anti-Regen
entries.ruleText: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

entries.name: Armor
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Defense X+.

entries.name: Bad Shot
entries.ruleText: This model gets -1 to hit rolls when shooting.

entries.name: Bane Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Bane on their weapons when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Bane in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Bane on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Bane in Melee Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Bane on its weapons in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Bane when Shooting
entries.ruleText: This model gets Bane on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Bane when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Bane on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Banner
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls.

entries.name: Battleborn
entries.ruleText: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

entries.name: Bloodborn
entries.ruleText: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

entries.name: Bounding
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

entries.name: Brace
entries.ruleText: Enemies charging this unit get -X total Impact rolls, unless this unit is Fatigued.

entries.name: Bravery Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +1 to Morale Test rolls.

entries.name: Bravery Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Caster Group
entries.ruleText: Pick one model with this rule in this unit to have Caster(X), where X is the total number of models with this rule in this unit. If the model is killed, pick another to be the new caster, and transfer all spell tokens to it. The caster loses all unspent spell tokens at the end of the round.

entries.name: Casting Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 12" with Caster, which gets +1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Changebound
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .

entries.name: Clan Warrior
entries.ruleText: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

entries.name: Coordinate
entries.ruleText: At the end of this unit's activation, another friendly unit within 12" that hasn't activated yet may be activated immediately. May not be used if this unit was activated via Coordinate.

entries.name: Counter in Melee
entries.ruleText: This model gets Counter on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Counter in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Counter on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Counter in Melee Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Counter in Melee.

entries.name: Crossing Attack
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

entries.name: Crossing Strike
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

entries.name: Dangerous Terrain Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Darkborn
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

entries.name: Dash
entries.ruleText: Once per round, at the end of this unit's activation, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

entries.name: Deathstrike
entries.ruleText: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits.

entries.name: Decimate
entries.ruleText: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

entries.name: Defense Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Defensive Frenzy
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule, place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token this unit gets +1 to Defense rolls until the end of the game.

entries.name: Defensive Growth
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule,  place one token on it at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four tokens. For every two tokens, this unit gets +1 to Defense rolls.

entries.name: Delayed Action
entries.ruleText: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later).

entries.name: Demolish
entries.ruleText: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units with most models within 1" of terrain, this weapon gets AP(+1).

entries.name: Destructive
entries.ruleText: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), those hits get AP(+1).

entries.name: Devout
entries.ruleText: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

entries.name: Difficult Terrain Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Difficult terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Disintegrate
entries.ruleText: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(3) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2).

entries.name: Dodge
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

entries.name: Enhanced Bloodborn
entries.ruleText: If this model has Bloodborn, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Bloodborn (instead of only on 6).

entries.name: Enhanced Changebound
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Changebound, enemies attacking them always get -1 to hit rolls from Changebound (instead of only when shooting/charging from over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Clan Warrior
entries.ruleText: If this model has Clan Warrior, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Clan Warrior (instead of only on 6).

entries.name: Enhanced Darkborn
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Darkborn, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8"/-4" range to a min. of 6" from Darkborn (instead of only -4"/-2").

entries.name: Enhanced Devout
entries.ruleText: If this model has Devout, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Devout (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Ferocious
entries.ruleText: If this model has Ferocious, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Ferocious (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Ferocious Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit Enhanced Ferocious.

entries.name: Enhanced Guardian
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Guardian, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Guardian (instead of only AP(-1)).

entries.name: Enhanced Guerrilla
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Guerrilla, they may move by up to 6" from Guerrilla (instead of only 3").

entries.name: Enhanced Harassing
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Harassing, they may move by up to 6" from Harassing (instead of only 3").

entries.name: Enhanced Havocbound
entries.ruleText: If this model has Havocbound, it always gets AP(+1) from Havocbound (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Highborn
entries.ruleText: If this model has Highborn, it gets +8"/+4" range when shooting/charging from Highborn (instead of only +4"/+2").

entries.name: Enhanced Hive Bond
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Hive Bond, they always get +1 to Morale Test rolls from Hive Bond (instead of only when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Hold the Line
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Hold the Line, they always get +1 to Morale Test rolls from Hold the Line (instead of only when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Infected
entries.ruleText: If this model has Infected, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Infected (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Knightborn
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Knightborn, they always ignore shooting/charging wounds on rolls of 6+ from Knightborn (instead of only when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Lustbound
entries.ruleText: If this model has Lustbound, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Lustbound (instead of only +1" and +2").

entries.name: Enhanced Machine-Fog
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Machine-Fog, enemies attacking them always get -1 to hit rolls from Machine-Fog (instead of only when shooting/charging from over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Mischievous
entries.ruleText: If this model has Mischievous, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Mischievous (instead of only results of 6).

entries.name: Enhanced Plaguebound
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Plaguebound, they ignore wounds on rolls of 5-6 from Plaguebound (instead of only on 6+).

entries.name: Enhanced Primal
entries.ruleText: If this model has Primal, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Primal (instead of only on 6).

entries.name: Enhanced Rapid Blink
entries.ruleText: If this model has Rapid Blink, it may move by up to 2D3" from Rapid Blink (instead of only D3").

entries.name: Enhanced Scrapper
entries.ruleText: If this model has Scrapper, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Scrapper (instead of only results of 6).

entries.name: Enhanced Scurry
entries.ruleText: If this model has Scurry, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Scurry (instead of only +1" and +2").

entries.name: Enhanced Self-Repair
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Self-Repair, they ignore wounds on rolls of 5-6 from Self-Repair (instead of only on 6+).

entries.name: Enhanced Shadowborn
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Shadowborn, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8"/-4" range to a min. of 6" from Shadowborn (instead of only -4"/-2").

entries.name: Enhanced Sturdy
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have Sturdy, they always get +1 to Defense rolls from Sturdy (instead of only when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Targeting Visor
entries.ruleText: If this model has Targeting Visor, it always gets +1 to hit rolls from Targeting Visor (instead of only when shooting over 9" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Warbound
entries.ruleText: If this model has Warbound, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Warbound (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Watchborn
entries.ruleText: If this model has Versatile Attack, it always gets either AP(+1) or +1 to hit rolls from Versatile Attack (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

entries.name: Enhanced Wolfborn
entries.ruleText: If this model has Wolfborn, it may move by up to 2D3" from Wolfborn (instead of only D3").

entries.name: Entrenched
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12” away get -1 to hit rolls.

entries.name: Evasive
entries.ruleText: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where most models have this rule.

entries.name: Extended Buff Range
entries.ruleText: If this unit is within 24" of another friendly unit with this rule that has a Hero in it, then that Hero may use special rules that allow it to pick friendly units within 12" (except for spells) on this unit as if it was in range.

entries.name: Fanatic
entries.ruleText: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

entries.name: Fast Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions.

entries.name: Fatigue Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed, it becomes Fatigued.

entries.name: Ferocious
entries.ruleText: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

entries.name: Fortified
entries.ruleText: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

entries.name: Fortified Growth
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule,  place one token on it at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four tokens. For every two tokens, enemies attacking this unit get AP(-1) to a min. of AP(0).

entries.name: Fracture
entries.ruleText: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+2).

entries.name: Fragment
entries.ruleText: When attacking units where most models have Defense 5+ to Defense 6+, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6.

entries.name: Good Shot
entries.ruleText: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting.

entries.name: Grounded Defense
entries.ruleText: If a unit where most models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, they get +1 to Defense rolls.

entries.name: Grounded Evasion
entries.ruleText: If a unit where most models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

entries.name: Grounded Precision
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit are within 1" of terrain, this model gets +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

entries.name: Guarded
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

entries.name: Guardian
entries.ruleText: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

entries.name: Guerrilla
entries.ruleText: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

entries.name: Harassing
entries.ruleText: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

entries.name: Havocbound
entries.ruleText: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, its weapons get AP(+1).

entries.name: Hazardous
entries.ruleText: Gets AP(4), but on unmodified results of 1 to hit this model takes one wound, or X wounds if this weapon has the Blast(X)/Deadly(X) rule.

entries.name: Heavy Impact
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

entries.name: Highborn
entries.ruleText: This model gets +4"/+2" range when shooting/charging.

entries.name: Hit & Run
entries.ruleText: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

entries.name: Hit & Run Fighter
entries.ruleText: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after being in melee.

entries.name: Hit & Run Shooter
entries.ruleText: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting.

entries.name: Hive Bond
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

entries.name: Hold the Line
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

entries.name: Honor Code
entries.ruleText: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

entries.name: Imprecise
entries.ruleText: Gets -1 to hit when attacking.

entries.name: Increased Shooting Range
entries.ruleText: This model gets +6" range on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +6" range on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Increased Shooting Range Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +6" range on its weapons when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Increased Shooting Range Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +6" range on their weapons when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Indirect Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Indirect on their weapons against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Indirect when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Indirect on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Infected
entries.ruleText: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

entries.name: Infiltrate
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

entries.name: Infiltrating Precision Strike
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Infiltrate, and gets +1 to hit rolls in melee on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

entries.name: Inquisitorial Agent
entries.ruleText: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being Fatigued when activated again). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round.

entries.name: Instinctive
entries.ruleText: When this model is activated, if it is able to shoot/charge an enemy unit, then it must immediately attack the closest valid target and gets +1 to hit rolls for that attack.

entries.name: Knightborn
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, and the unit was shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

entries.name: Lacerate
entries.ruleText: When attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

entries.name: Lustbound
entries.ruleText: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

entries.name: Machine-Fog
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .

entries.name: Martial Prowess
entries.ruleText: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being Fatigued when activated again). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round.

entries.name: Melee Evasion
entries.ruleText: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

entries.name: Melee Shrouding
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for charging, that enemy unit gets -2" range to a min. of 6".

entries.name: Melee Slayer
entries.ruleText: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.

entries.name: Mend
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

entries.name: Mind Control
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction. Units may only be moved once per round in this way.

entries.name: Mischievous
entries.ruleText: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

entries.name: Morale Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Musician
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit moves +1" when using move actions.

entries.name: No Retreat
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

entries.name: Obliterate
entries.ruleText: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(3) or higher, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6.

entries.name: Parry
entries.ruleText: When this unit takes hits in melee, roll X dice per model with this rule in it, up to as many dice as hits taken. For each 6+ one hit is ignored (defender picks which).

entries.name: Pierce
entries.ruleText: Ignores all positive Defense modifiers on the target, and when attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, this weapon gets AP(+1).

entries.name: Piercing Charge
entries.ruleText: This model gets AP(+1) on its weapons when charging.

entries.name: Piercing Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which loses AP(1) on its weapons when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Piercing Fighter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get AP(+1) on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Piercing Frenzy
entries.ruleText: Place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token all models with this rule in this unit get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking until the end of the game.

entries.name: Piercing Growth
entries.ruleText: Place one token on this unit at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four tokens. For every two tokens, models with this rule in this unit get AP(+1) on their weapons.

entries.name: Piercing Marksman
entries.ruleText: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

entries.name: Piercing Shooter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get AP(+1) on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Piercing Shooting Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets AP(+1) on their weapons when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Piercing Spotter
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(X) on their weapons, where X is the number of removed tokens.

entries.name: Piercing Tag
entries.ruleText: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, place X tokens on one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight, or one token on X enemy units within 24" and in line of sight. When attacking, friendly units may remove one token from their target before rolling to block to get AP(+1) on their weapons.

entries.name: Piercing Target
entries.ruleText: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them.

entries.name: Plaguebound
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

entries.name: Precise
entries.ruleText: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

entries.name: Precision Attacks Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Precision Charge
entries.ruleText: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when charging.

entries.name: Precision Charge Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls when charging.

entries.name: Precision Fighter

entries.name: Precision Fighter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls in melee.

entries.name: Precision Fighting Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls when shooting.

entries.name: Precision Shooter Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Precision Shooting Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove one token from their target before rolling to hit to get +1 to hit rolls.

entries.name: Precision Target
entries.ruleText: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

entries.name: Predator
entries.ruleText: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

entries.name: Predator Shooter
entries.ruleText: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when shooting, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

entries.name: Primal
entries.ruleText: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

entries.name: Primeborn
entries.ruleText: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

entries.name: Protected
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

entries.name: Protection Feat
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this unit takes wounds and most of its models have this rule, you may use this rule and roll one die per wound, and on a 5+ it is ignored.

entries.name: Puncture
entries.ruleText: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).

entries.name: Purge
entries.ruleText: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, this weapon gets AP(+2).

entries.name: Quick Shot
entries.ruleText: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

entries.name: Quick Throw
entries.ruleText: This model may always target enemies that are not in line of sight when shooting with Indirect weapons (instead of only when using Hold actions).

entries.name: Ranged Shrouding
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting, that enemy unit gets -4" range to a min. of 6".

entries.name: Ranged Slayer
entries.ruleText: When using Hold actions and shooting, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.

entries.name: Rapid Advance
entries.ruleText: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.

entries.name: Rapid Ambush
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed at the start of any round, including the first.

entries.name: Rapid Blink
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3".

entries.name: Rapid Charge
entries.ruleText: This model moves +4" when using Charge actions.

entries.name: Rapid Charge Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit moves +4" when using Charge actions.

entries.name: Rapid Rush
entries.ruleText: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.

entries.name: Ravage
entries.ruleText: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

entries.name: Ravage Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Ravage(+1).

entries.name: Re-Deployment
entries.ruleText: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

entries.name: Reanimation
entries.ruleText: When a unit where all models have this rule is activated, roll as many dice as the max. number of models/wounds it could restore. For each 5+ you may restore one model/wound. Note that new models may only be restored if they can be placed in coherency with non-restored models.

entries.name: Reap
entries.ruleText: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6.

entries.name: Regenerative Strength
entries.ruleText: Place one token on this model when it ignores a wound. Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll as many dice as tokens on it before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 4+ the target takes one wound.

entries.name: Reinforcement
entries.ruleText: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken, you may remove it from the table as destroyed. At the beginning of the next round after a unit where all models have this rule is destroyed, after Ambushers have been deployed, you may place a new copy of it fully within 9" of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn’t apply to the new copy of the unit.

entries.name: Rending Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Rending on their weapons against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Rending in Melee
entries.ruleText: This model gets Rending on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Rending in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Rending on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Rending when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Rending on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Repel Ambushers
entries.ruleText: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

entries.name: Retaliate
entries.ruleText: When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken.

entries.name: Scourge
entries.ruleText: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, enemies count as having taken 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

entries.name: Scrapper
entries.ruleText: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

entries.name: Screened
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .

entries.name: Scurry
entries.ruleText: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

entries.name: Self-Destruct
entries.ruleText: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits. If this model survives melee, after both sides have finished attacking, it is immediately killed, and the enemy unit takes X hits.

entries.name: Self-Repair
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

entries.name: Sergeant
entries.ruleText: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

entries.name: Shadowborn
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

entries.name: Shatter
entries.ruleText: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+3).

entries.name: Shielded
entries.ruleText: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

entries.name: Shred Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Shred on their weapons when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Shred in Melee
entries.ruleText: This model gets Shred on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Shred in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Shred on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Shred when Shooting
entries.ruleText: This model gets Shred on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Shred when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Shred on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Slayer
entries.ruleText: When using Hold actions and shooting, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.

entries.name: Smash
entries.ruleText: When attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

entries.name: Spawn
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it. Units placed via Spawn can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they are placed.

entries.name: Speed Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Speed Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Speed Feat
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this unit moves, you may use this rule so that all models with this rule in it move +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions.

entries.name: Spell Accumulator
entries.ruleText: Gets X accumulator tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. Casters from other friendly units within 12" may spend this model's accumulator tokens as if they were their own spell tokens. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

entries.name: Spell Conduit
entries.ruleText: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

entries.name: Spell Drain
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed, it loses 2 spell tokens.

entries.name: Spell Resistance
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

entries.name: Split
entries.ruleText: When this unit is fully destroyed, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it before removing the last model. Units placed via Split can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they are placed.

entries.name: Steadfast
entries.ruleText: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

entries.name: Sturdy
entries.ruleText: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Infiltrate. The first time this unit is activated, pick one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight, and roll X dice. For each 2+ it takes one hit with AP(1).

entries.name: Swift
entries.ruleText: This model may ignore the Slow rule.

entries.name: Takedown Shot
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make X extra attacks against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

entries.name: Takedown Strike
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

entries.name: Targeting Visor
entries.ruleText: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.

entries.name: Teleport
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

entries.name: Thrust in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Thrust on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Thrust in Melee Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Thrust in Melee once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Unique Hero
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

entries.name: Unpredictable
entries.ruleText: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

entries.name: Unpredictable Fighter
entries.ruleText: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

entries.name: Unpredictable Shooter
entries.ruleText: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

entries.name: Unstoppable Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable on their weapons against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Unstoppable in Melee
entries.ruleText: This model gets Unstoppable on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Unstoppable in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Unstoppable on its weapons in melee.

entries.name: Unstoppable when Shooting
entries.ruleText: This model gets Unstoppable on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Unstoppable when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Unstoppable on its weapons when shooting.

entries.name: Unwieldy
entries.ruleText: Strikes last when charging.

entries.name: Unwieldy Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy on its weapons in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Vanguard
entries.ruleText: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

entries.name: Vengeance
entries.ruleText: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance tokens on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking that unit, where X is the number of tokens on it.

entries.name: Versatile Defense
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule is shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, pick one effect: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.

entries.name: Versatile Expert
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

entries.name: Versatile Reach
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, all models with this rule in this unit either get +4" range when shooting or move +2" when charging.

entries.name: Versatile Warrior
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.

entries.name: Warbound
entries.ruleText: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

entries.name: Watchborn
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.

entries.name: Wolfborn
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3".
